data.name: ShowLocalHistory
data.comment: The action that lists a file's or folder's versions, named in a sentence; {keys} may follow it in brackets.

data.name: ListsVersionsHere
data.value: {action} on a file or folder lists its versions here
data.comment: The Local History window's words while no history is open; {action} names the action with its keys.

data.name: RevertSelectedAndLater
data.comment: A history's button and row menu item: puts back what the chosen change set and those after it changed.

data.name: RevertSelection
data.comment: A folder's history: puts back the chosen files alone, as they were before the chosen change set.

data.name: SelectActivity
data.comment: The diff's place while no row of the history is chosen.

data.name: SearchByFileName
data.comment: A folder's history's search field.

data.name: SearchByContent
data.comment: A file's history's search field.

data.name: NoMatchingActivity
data.comment: A history's list where the search keeps no row; {name} is the file or folder.

data.name: NoActivity
data.comment: A history's list where nothing was kept; {name} is the file or folder.

data.name: NoChanges
data.comment: A folder's history where no file differs since the chosen change set.

data.name: LabelVersion
data.comment: The diff's left side for a label: its name and when it was put.

data.name: VersionBefore
data.comment: The diff's left side: the file before a change set, named by what the set did, and when.

data.name: Current
data.comment: The diff's right side: the file as it stands now.

data.name: FileGone
data.comment: The diff's side, or its place, where the file did not exist then or does not now.

data.name: ChangedFiles
data.comment: A change set's title in a folder's history where it changed several files: the last, and how many others.

data.name: Created
data.comment: A change set's title where it made a file.

data.name: Deleted
data.comment: A change set's title where it deleted a file.

data.name: Renamed
data.comment: A change set's title where it renamed a file in its folder.

data.name: Moved
data.comment: A change set's title where it moved a file to another folder.

data.name: Changed
data.comment: A change set's title in a file's own history, where it changed the file.

data.name: Modified
data.comment: A change set's title in a folder's history where it changed one file.

data.name: RecentChanges
data.comment: The popup listing the open folder's change sets.

data.name: SearchByName
data.comment: Recent Changes' search field.

data.name: NoRecentChanges
data.comment: Recent Changes where Local History kept none.
